This role focuses on currency exposure identification, analysis, and trading operations for the in-house bank, including regular reporting.
Additional responsibilities include:
Lead intercompany hedging operations for the in-house trading company and handle related currency trading with 3rd party banks
Prepare, review, and distribute monthly financial reports tied to the company's intercompany and 3rd party foreign currency hedging programs
Provide financial and analytical support for the in-house bank, in-house trading company, Headquarter Companies, affiliates, and management
Coordinate with 3rd party banks, vendors, and CTU customers to support improvements in financial and operational outcomes
Operate independently with moderate supervision under time constraints
Support the CTU manager with:
Administration of the cash flow hedge program
Analysis and preparation of quarterly LBEs and annual plan
Maintaining systems, workstations, procedures, directories, and related tools
Quarterly/annual financial disclosures for 10-Q/K
Internal and external audit requests
Additional items as assigned
cond_0295.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 3 years of combined experience in Treasury, Finance, Accounting, or a related financial discipline
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field
Strong attention to detail, accountability, and sound decision-making skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience managing foreign exchange and working with International Affiliates in Corporate Treasury
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently and within a team
Clear written and verbal communication skills

Lead daily intercompany hedging operations for the in-house trading company and related currency trading with 3rd party bank

Work closely with 3rd party banks, vendors, and CTU customers to improve financial and operational outcomes
Operate independently with moderate supervision and challenging time constraints

Administration of the cash flow hedge program

Quarterly/annual financial disclosures for 10 Q/K
Internal and external audit requests

A minimum of 3 years combined experience in Treasury, Finance Accounting or related financial discipline
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or Business or related field.
Prior experience managing foreign exchange and working with International Affiliates in Corporate Treasury is highly desired.
Strong attention to detail, accountability, independent and proactive thought, and decision-making skills are critical.
Requires strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills with ability to work independently and within a team setting.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required.
